doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Claude Black at Fuller's Detroit high school
summary: Brower asks about Claude Black, who came to the high school with the top eastside Detroit band that included Donald Byrd and Roland Hanna.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Going back to your development, Claude Black.
Let’s talk about him because in this business of learning the trombone and the baritone horn and all of that, somewhere he’s in the mix.
He’s in the mix very much.

When I met Claude black, he came to our high school to play. And the band that he was in when he came to our high school to play, they had the top band in the eastside or whatever, in Detroit. It was Robert Barnes, Donald Byrd, Roland Hana, Claude Black on French Horn and trombone.
See, I know him as a piano player.
